name: Epic Boon of Fate
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits:

  • Ability Score Increase.

    Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

  • Improve Fate.

    When another creature within 60 feet of you fails a d20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. You can use this benefit no more than once per turn. You have 8 uses of this benefit, and whenever you finish a Long Rest|XUA2023DruidAndPaladin, you regain 2d4 expended uses.

name: Epic Boon of Spell Recall
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits:

  • Ability Score Increase.

    Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

  • Free Casting.

    Whenever you cast a spell with a Spell Slot of 1st, 2nd, 3rd, or 4th level, roll a d4. If the number you roll equals the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.
